framework.purpose: Define the final feasible prospective packet protocol for deciding whether a leakage-clean P_oe + B_min row packet can be assembled. This protocol does not claim that R_oe exists.
framework.independence_constraint: This A Round 3 output did not read current-CphiPacket/B or any B output file. PI synthesis was used only because it was explicitly allowed.

canonical_definitions.P_oe: P_oe = (chi_odd - chi_even) / (chi_odd + chi_even), with denominator-floor censoring only.
canonical_definitions.P_oe_L1_diagnostic: Diagnostic-only robustness value; it cannot replace canonical P_oe in the primary call.
canonical_definitions.B_min: A pre-output baseline block covering oxygen, structure, orbital/valence, disorder, pressure path, ordinary c-axis state, and sample quality without using superconducting outputs or P_oe fit nuisance terms.

final_protocol.summary: Assemble same-sample rows where possible and pre-toleranced matched-sibling rows where necessary. Freeze row IDs, grids, censoring, U_miss, B_min extraction, P_oe extraction, and output embargo before any superconducting-output reveal. Admit only green rows to the primary packet; use yellow rows for sensitivity; reject red rows.

ordered_steps.name: pre_registration_and_blinding
requirements: assign opaque row_id, batch_id, sibling_set_id, lab_id, probe_run_id, and pressure_load_id
freeze q, omega, qz, polarization, temperature, and pressure grid
freeze epsilon_D derivation, P_oe censoring rules, B_min axes, U_miss buckets, row inclusion rules, and all sibling tolerances
appoint independent P_oe extractor, B_min extractor, firewall auditor, and output custodian
use blinded specimen names and timestamped audit logs for file names, lab notes, transfers, exclusions, and threshold freezes

ordered_steps.name: genealogy_and_low_damage_baselines
requirements: record growth lot, precursor lot, anneal schedule, cut order, storage, dimensions, orientation, mass, and visible defects
acquire nondestructive XRD/Raman/orientation/quality checks before high-dose probes
assign destructive probes to pre-registered sibling pieces only when same-sample measurement is unavailable

ordered_steps.name: B_min_acquisition
requirements: measure oxygen stoichiometry/layer asymmetry, phase fraction, structural strain, orbital/valence/ligand-hole proxies, disorder, pressure path, ordinary c-axis state, and sample damage
primary B_min c-axis covariates must come from independently acquired normal-state optical, transport, structural, or non-P_oe spectroscopy whenever available

same-session qz/RIXS-derived c-axis or matrix-element-adjacent covariates are yellow sensitivity-only unless the firewall audit proves they are reproducible with P_oe spectra and odd/even nuisance terms hidden

ordered_steps.name: pressure_path_lock
requirements: record pressure medium, marker series, gradient estimate, load/unload path, dwell time, thermal cycles, gasket/culet geometry, and pressure-cell identity
freeze pressure landmark mapping before P_oe residual modeling
exclude rows with unledgered pressure history from primary analysis

ordered_steps.name: P_oe_spectroscopy
requirements: acquire normal-state odd/even contrast-sensitive susceptibility data on the frozen grid
archive raw spectra, standards, blank/dark files, geometry/self-absorption corrections, channel-mixing covariance, and fit code
compute canonical P_oe only after deriving epsilon_D from susceptibility-channel calibration artifacts
censor rows or cells with abs(chi_odd + chi_even) <= epsilon_D

ordered_steps.name: row_firewall_and_packet_lock
requirements: classify every row green, yellow, or red before output reveal
freeze P_oe, P_oe_L1_diagnostic, B_min, U_miss, censor flags, row inclusion, audit logs, and extraction hashes
admit only green rows into the primary packet
do not rescue any row by comparing mismatch or missingness to observed superconducting outcomes or residual behavior

ordered_steps.name: post_lock_output_reveal
requirements: output custodian reveals superconducting labels only after packet lock
residual-collapse or R_oe analysis, if any, occurs in a separate downstream phase
this packet protocol can only make feasibility and executability claims, not R_oe existence claims

final_protocol.primary_packet_rule: Primary packet = green rows only. Yellow rows can support robustness and sensitivity statements. Red rows are excluded or trigger full protocol failure if contamination affected design-level choices.

green.meaning: Primary-analysis row with enough independence, calibration, genealogy, and blinding to test later residual behavior without known leakage.
required_conditions: canonical P_oe valid and uncensored on the frozen grid
epsilon_D derived only from susceptibility-channel calibration, noise, blank/standard residuals, and channel-mixing covariance
B_min reproducible with P_oe spectra, odd/even fit parameters, P_oe residuals, and output labels hidden
no B_min field uses qz/polarization/form-factor nuisance terms from P_oe extraction
primary ordinary c-axis covariate is independently acquired or audit-proven independent of P_oe nuisance terms
all core B_min axes present: oxygen/layer asymmetry, structure/phase fraction, pressure path, ordinary c-axis state, sample quality/damage, and output embargo
same-sample row or sibling row passing all pre-output mismatch tolerances
raw spectra, calibration files, extraction code, and timestamped blinded-ID logs are archived
row selection and exclusion logs predate output reveal
green.allowed_use: primary packet, tier thresholds, later residual protocol

yellow.meaning: Potentially informative but not primary-identifying row. It may be used only for sensitivity, rehearsal, engineering diagnosis, or facility debugging.
conditions: P_oe valid but one non-core B_min axis is proxy-only with pre-registered U_miss inflation
same-session non-P_oe RIXS/qz/c-axis proxy is used but is extracted from independently defined spectral regions and passes a partial firewall audit
sibling mismatch is below hard red limits but above green tolerance on one non-core axis
raw archive complete but one calibration repeat or blind duplicate is missing for the run
row belongs to an otherwise valid packet but batch/lab replication is below decision-grade
yellow.allowed_use: sensitivity-only; cannot count toward green-row thresholds

red.meaning: Excluded row or design-level protocol failure.
row_exclusion_conditions: canonical P_oe denominator is replaced rather than censored
abs(chi_odd + chi_even) <= epsilon_D for the primary cell
epsilon_D uses B_min fields, superconducting outputs, residual behavior, or post-reveal tuning
B_min cannot be reproduced without P_oe spectra, odd/even nuisance parameters, channel-mixing residuals, or output labels
ordinary c-axis B_min field is the same fitted qz/matrix-element state used to construct P_oe
sibling mismatch exceeds red tolerance on oxygen, phase fraction, pressure path, beam damage, c-axis state, or quality
pressure path ledger is missing for a pressure-dependent row
raw spectra or calibration archive is unavailable
row selection used known Tc, zero resistance, Meissner/diamagnetism, superconducting gap, critical current, superconducting resonance, or output-trained human/model labels
full_protocol_failure_conditions: output knowledge influenced grid choice, thresholds, row inclusion rules, pressure landmarks, sample selection, or covariate selection
file names, lab notes, or specimen labels systematically encode superconducting success before packet lock
P_oe and B_min extraction teams are not separable and no blinded reconstruction audit is possible
red contamination affects enough rows that green-row tier thresholds cannot be met
red.allowed_use: none for primary or sensitivity claims except as documented failure evidence

sibling_tolerances.principle: All mismatch tolerances are frozen before output reveal and before residual analysis. A sibling row cannot be rescued by post-hoc comparison to observed residuals.

oxygen_microtexture.same_boule_cut_distance: adjacent or nearest-neighbor piece from same boule/cut sequence
oxygen_microtexture.oxygen_proxy_difference: <= 1 pooled pre-output standard deviation on the frozen oxygen metric and no layer-asymmetry class change
oxygen_microtexture.vacancy_or_EELS_map_difference: <= 10 percent relative difference where mapped, or within pre-registered instrument repeatability if repeatability is larger

phase_fraction.dominant_phase_rule: same dominant crystallographic phase and no new phase above detection limit

pressure_path.pressure_landmark_difference: <= 0.5 GPa or <= 10 percent of the landmark spacing, whichever is smaller
pressure_path.load_history: same medium, same pressure-cell class, matched load/unload direction, and matched thermal-cycle count within 1 cycle

beam_damage.pre_post_Raman_or_XRD_shift: <= instrument repeatability or <= 5 percent linewidth/peak-shift change

ordinary_c_axis_state.optical_or_transport_proxy_difference: <= 1 pooled pre-output standard deviation and no categorical coherence-state change
ordinary_c_axis_state.structure_proxy_difference: <= 1 pooled pre-output standard deviation on c-axis lattice/anisotropy proxy

sample_quality.RRR_or_normal_state_quality_difference: <= 15 percent relative difference where transport is allowed
sample_quality.crack_texture_rule: no new crack, delamination, or texture class change

yellow_range.definition: A row becomes yellow when exactly one non-core tolerance exceeds the green limit but remains below the red limit, and the excess is represented in frozen U_miss before output reveal.
yellow_range.upper_bound: yellow upper bound is 2 times the relevant green tolerance for non-core axes only

red_limits.oxygen_microtexture: > 2 pooled pre-output standard deviations, > 20 percent mapped vacancy/proxy difference, or layer-asymmetry class change
red_limits.phase_fraction: > 10 absolute percentage points minor-phase difference, dominant-phase change, or unledgered new phase
red_limits.pressure_path: > 1.0 GPa landmark difference, > 25 percent landmark-spacing difference, opposite load/unload branch, different pressure medium, or missing marker series
red_limits.beam_damage: > 10 percent linewidth/peak-shift change, visible probe-induced damage, or unlogged dose history
red_limits.ordinary_c_axis_state: > 2 pooled pre-output standard deviations or categorical c-axis coherence-state change
red_limits.sample_quality: > 25 percent rocking-curve/mosaicity/RRR difference, crack/delamination class change, or missing quality ledger

sibling_tolerances.same_sample_override: Same-sample measurement is required when a core sibling tolerance cannot be measured, when pressure path is the tested variable and cannot be sibling-matched, or when destructive-probe siblings exceed any red limit.

facility_acceptance.principle: A facility/probe route is accepted only if it can produce auditable green rows under blinding, raw-archive, calibration, and firewall constraints.

required_capabilities: normal-state odd/even contrast-sensitive susceptibility measurement on frozen q/omega/qz/polarization/T/P grid
calibration standards, blank/dark or equivalent background files, elastic-line or resolution calibration, geometry/self-absorption correction, and channel-mixing covariance
raw spectra archive with immutable URI and refittable code
blind duplicate spectra or repeated standard per acquisition run
ability to keep superconducting-output labels hidden from the P_oe extractor
acceptance_metrics: abs(chi_odd + chi_even) / epsilon_D > 1 for validity and > 3 preferred for decision-grade quantitative rows
P_oe sign is stable under the frozen channel-mixing uncertainty for green rows
calibration repeat drift <= 10 percent of the susceptibility denominator floor budget
missing primary grid cells <= 10 percent for green rows
raw archive completeness = 100 percent for rows counted green

required_capabilities: oxygen/layer-asymmetry measurement by direct or calibrated proxy route
structure and phase-fraction measurement by XRD/Raman/microscopy or equivalent
orbital/valence/ligand-hole proxy by XAS/XES/EELS or equivalent
disorder/sample-quality measurement by rocking curve, Raman linewidth, defect density, normal-state quality metric, or equivalent
pressure path ledger with marker series, medium, gradient, load/unload path, dwell, thermal cycles, and cell geometry
ordinary c-axis proxy from independent normal-state optical/transport/structural route where possible
acceptance_metrics: B_min table can be regenerated with P_oe spectra, P_oe fit parameters, and output labels hidden
all core axes present for green rows
at most one non-core proxy-only axis for yellow rows and none for decision-grade green rows
same-session qz/RIXS-derived B_min proxies are sensitivity-only unless an auditor can reproduce them without P_oe nuisance terms
U_miss ranges are frozen before output reveal

required_capabilities: opaque row IDs and blinded specimen labels
timestamped logs for sample transfer, file naming, exclusion, threshold freeze, and packet lock
separate extraction hashes for P_oe and B_min
auditor can reconstruct green/yellow/red classification before output reveal
acceptance_metrics: no superconducting-output field or output-trained label is visible before packet lock
all inclusion/exclusion timestamps precede output reveal
packet lock hash exists before output reveal
any unblinded design-level choice triggers PROTOCOL_FAILURE

facility_status_labels.ACCEPT_FOR_REHEARSAL: Facility can produce N=12 machinery rows with raw archive, blinding, and at least partial B_min/P_oe separation.
facility_status_labels.ACCEPT_FOR_MINIMUM_EXECUTABLE: Facility set can produce N=24 with >=18 green canonical P_oe rows, >=2 batches, all core axes, and firewall audit.
facility_status_labels.ACCEPT_FOR_DECISION_GRADE: Facility network can produce N=48 with >=36 green complete rows, >=4 batches, >=3 labs, leave-one-batch/lab-out validation, and no yellow rows needed for the primary result.
facility_status_labels.REJECT_FOR_PRIMARY_PACKET: Facility/probe route cannot hide outputs, cannot archive raw calibration, cannot separate B_min from P_oe nuisance terms, or cannot ledger pressure/sibling identity.

rehearsal.label: REHEARSAL_ONLY
rehearsal.allowed_claim: The packet machinery can be rehearsed. No residual-collapse, R_oe, or decision-grade claim is allowed.

minimum_executable.label: MINIMUM_EXECUTABLE_PROTOCOL
minimum_executable.allowed_claim: The bounded packet protocol is executable as a prospective experiment. This is not decision-grade and does not establish R_oe.

decision_grade.label: DECISION_GRADE_PACKET

exact_thresholds.blind_duplicates: >= 4 total and distributed across at least 2 labs
exact_thresholds.same_session_qz_c_axis_B_min_proxy_in_pr: 0 unless independently reproduced without P_oe nuisance terms

decision_grade.allowed_claim: The packet is strong enough to support a later decision-grade residual protocol. Even here, the packet alone does not assert that R_oe exists.

hard_fails: denominator-censored fraction > 35 percent for minimum executable or > 25 percent for decision-grade
any pressure landmark has < 3 valid rows for minimum executable or < 6 for decision-grade
single-batch packet used for any executable claim
missing raw archive for any primary row
output embargo violation before packet lock
B_min requires hidden P_oe nuisance terms or output labels

NOT_FOUND.definition: Existing or proposed evidence is component-only and cannot be assembled into rows satisfying the schema.
triggers: literature or facility records lack same-sample or pre-toleranced sibling row identity
P_oe and B_min are available only from incompatible specimens, pressure histories, or known-output studies
raw calibration archives or row-level genealogy are absent
no prospective facility route has committed to the required grid, blinding, and archive
NOT_FOUND.allowed_statement: No executable packet has been found.

NON_DECISION_GRADE.definition: A packet exists or can be rehearsed/executed, but it fails the decision-grade tier.
triggers: N=24 with >=18 green rows and >=2 batches but not N=48 / >=36 complete rows / >=4 batches / >=3 labs
yellow rows are needed for any apparent signal
leave-one-batch/lab-out validation is unavailable or fails
NON_DECISION_GRADE.allowed_statement: The protocol may be executable, but it cannot carry a decision-grade residual claim.

NON_IDENTIFIABLE.definition: The packet cannot separate P_oe from B_min or row identity even prospectively.
triggers: B_min ordinary c-axis or structural covariates require the same qz/matrix-element fitted state used for P_oe
B_min table cannot be regenerated with P_oe spectra and odd/even nuisance terms hidden
P_oe denominator floor or row inclusion depends on B_min or residual behavior
sibling mismatch exceeds red tolerance on a core axis and same-sample replacement is unavailable
pressure path cannot be ledgered tightly enough to distinguish pressure history from P_oe residual structure
NON_IDENTIFIABLE.allowed_statement: This packet class cannot identify the bounded residual question.

PROTOCOL_FAILURE.definition: The design violates blinding, calibration, archiving, or pre-registration rules.
triggers: superconducting-output labels influence sample selection, thresholds, grids, covariates, row inclusion, or pressure landmarks
canonical P_oe is replaced by a stabilized denominator in the primary field
epsilon_D is tuned after seeing residual behavior or output labels
raw spectra/calibration files are missing for primary rows
timestamped blind-ID audit logs are absent and output leakage cannot be ruled out
PROTOCOL_FAILURE.allowed_statement: The packet attempt failed procedurally and cannot support primary inference.

PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE.definition: A prospective, facility-plausible protocol exists whose green-row requirements are not internally contradictory and whose minimum or decision-grade thresholds are explicit before measurement.
required_conditions: sibling tolerances are frozen before output reveal
facility/probe acceptance metrics are satisfied at least at the intended tier
output embargo and timestamped blind-ID logs are in place
threshold tier is declared as rehearsal, minimum executable, or decision-grade
PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE.allowed_statement: The packet is feasible as a near-future prospective protocol if the listed facility and firewall conditions are met. This remains a feasibility claim, not a measured-data claim.

final_claim_boundary.PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE: A forward-designed packet can plausibly be assembled with current or near-future facilities if it satisfies the green-row firewall, pre-output sibling tolerances, facility acceptance metrics, and the declared tier thresholds. It means the experiment is protocol-feasible, not that the packet already exists.
final_claim_boundary.NOT_FOUND: Existing public or retrospective data remain insufficient when they cannot be converted into sealed row-level P_oe + B_min entries with raw calibration, genealogy, blinding, and firewall audits.
final_claim_boundary.NON_DECISION_GRADE: A rehearsal or minimum executable packet may exist but lacks the N/batch/lab/validation structure for a decision-grade residual test.
final_claim_boundary.NON_IDENTIFIABLE: The B_min/P_oe or sibling/pressure separation fails in principle for the row class, so more rows of the same contaminated kind cannot solve the problem.
final_claim_boundary.PROTOCOL_FAILURE: The packet attempt violates pre-registration, blinding, calibration, archive, or canonical P_oe rules.

allowed_claims: A final prospective feasible packet protocol is now specified.
A minimum executable packet requires N>=24, >=18 green valid uncensored P_oe rows, >=2 batches, intact embargo, full core B_min, and a passed B_min/P_oe firewall.
A decision-grade packet requires N>=48, >=36 green complete rows, >=4 batches, >=3 labs, and leave-one-batch/lab-out validation.
Existing retrospective literature status remains NOT_FOUND unless row-level schema, raw archive, blinding, and firewall conditions can be reconstructed.
forbidden_claims: The current literature already validates the packet.
A yellow-row sensitivity result can substitute for a green-row primary packet.
Sibling mismatch can be repaired after output reveal by comparing it to observed residual behavior.
claims.final_verdict: PACKET_FEASIBLE_NEAR_FUTURE as a prospective protocol only; current measured packet status remains NOT_FOUND.

remaining_warnings: The numerical sibling tolerances are protocol gates and should be tightened by facility repeatability studies before live acquisition.
Facility acceptance remains conditional until actual beamline, pressure-cell, spectroscopy, microscopy, and blinding ledgers are confirmed.
Decision-grade thresholds are protocol thresholds, not statistical power theorems.
The protocol can decide whether a packet is executable; it does not itself decide or validate R_oe.
